answer: Each seat inherits the vine of the founder its sponsorship line descends from. A newcomer votes only after seats from three different vines each lock 10 karst behind it, and each vine may back one newcomer per horizon of 30 epochs. An honest newcomer needs three unrelated sponsors. An operator wanting k clones in one horizon must bribe seats in 3k separate vines and put 30k karst at risk of forfeiture. With 90 vines, his 30th clone needs the last unbought lineages, the costliest holdouts.
